chain_words.nuance: offering an idea softly, without strong commitment
stating something as true, often without proof
giving reasons to support a position
firmly maintaining a position against opposition
refusing to accept any other view, with great force

explanation: These five verbs all describe putting forward a position in a debate, moving from a gentle suggestion to a forceful insistence.

usage_notes.difference: 'Argue' describes presenting reasons for a view, while 'insist' suggests the speaker will not yield, whatever the counter-arguments.
